refactor(Mountain): Consolidate fix_rustdocs.py and trim doc text

Refactor fix_rustdocs.py to reduce duplication: inline the standalone
get_pub_items logic, consolidate meta-pattern regex replacements into a
single list, deduplicate the split_pascal utility, remove unused imports
(glob, shutil), and collapse the TARGET_MODULES list format. Rename helpers
for clarity (fix_meta_instructional -> fix_meta, pascal_to_verb_phrase ->
pascal_to_verb).

Also remove the redundant "This is" prefix from two DTO doc-comment
continuation lines (ExtensionDescriptionStateDTO, WebviewStateDTO) where
the preceding line already establishes the subject, so the comment reads
as a single continuous sentence.
